title: The Signature Author and Researcher Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Researcher profiles, affiliations, and publication identifiers. The Author and Researcher Database profiles researchers with public information only: current affiliation, research areas, publication identifiers such as ORCID, and links to lawfully accessible publications. Name disambiguation separates researchers who share names. The Signature side adds collaboration-network maps showing who publishes with whom in each field.
capabilities: Profile researchers with affiliations and research areas
Record ORCID and other publication identifiers
Disambiguate researchers who share names
Link to lawfully accessible publication lists
Map collaboration networks within fields

body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout.
